fusions.name: Cinching Blow
fusions.desc: Cinches a cord tight around the target and deals 14 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Drawn Cord
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Snaps a drawn cord that deals 8 damage, up to 1.8 times that at maximum range, and slows what it hits by 20% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Winch Surge
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 15 seconds. Your movement speed rises by 20% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Taut Stitch
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you deal 50% more physical damage for 8 seconds. Once every 60 seconds. Your armour is 10% higher.
